title: Stop The Wedding

(shout 'stop the wedding' then give a tiny objection; sound Rising 82K Reels, more than doubled in under three weeks, SocialPilot Instagram Reels trends Nov 17-25 2026, US) — bait-and-switch objection skit: at Lily and Marcus's small fall wedding in the park, Grandpa Leon keeps standing up to stop it over smaller and smaller things while officiant Aunt Rhonda loses patience; twist: he is stalling for the ice cream truck he booked, because at six Lily made him promise one at her wedding; button: the truck arrives, and Rhonda stops the wedding herself — they are out of chocolate
youtube_title: Grandpa stood up and stopped the wedding. Then he did it again. And again 💍
description:
Lily and Marcus are getting married in the park. Grandpa Leon has an objection. Then another one. Then another one. Nobody knows what he is waiting for.

#cartoon #animation #funny #wedding #shorts
tiktok_caption: grandpa stopped the wedding. three times. 💍 #cartoon #animation #funny #wedding

lines.text: If anyone here objects to this wedding, speak now, or forever hold your peace.
Stop the wedding!
Grandpa?
The chairs are wobbly. Somebody could fall in love and then fall down.
Sir, that is not an objection. That is furniture.
Leon. I am an aunt with a borrowed microphone. Do not test me.
Fine. I fixed the chair with a napkin. Carry on.
Thank you. Now, Lily and Marcus, we are gathered here today.
Under this beautiful tree, which has a sign that says do not climb the tree.
Stop the wedding!
Grandpa, we are four sentences in.
The groom's shoes squeak. Every step sounds like a little duck.
They are new. They are rented. They are a size nine and I am a size eleven.
A man who walks like a duck can still be a good husband. I withdraw.
Does anybody else have a problem with ducks? No? Wonderful.
Marcus, do you have the vows you wrote?
I do. Lily, the day I met you, you were eating a hot dog in the rain.
It was a very good hot dog.
And I thought, that is a woman who does not wait for the weather.
Stop the wedding!
Leon, that was a nice part.
I have a pebble in my shoe. It feels like a mountain.
That is your shoe, Grandpa. That is not our wedding.
Everything is connected, sweetheart.
Take off the shoe. Shake the shoe. Put the shoe back. We are moving.
Oh. It was a raisin. That is worse.
Is he okay? He keeps checking the street.
He checks the street at everything. He checked the street at my graduation.
Lily, your vows. Quickly. Like a bandage.
Marcus, you are kind, you are tall, and you always share the last fry.
Not always.
Almost always. And that is enough for me.
Stop the wedding.
I am going to stop you, Leon.
There is a bird on that branch. He looks like he has concerns.
Sir, the bird has not said anything.
That is how you know. The quiet ones always have concerns.
Grandpa, what is going on? Do you not like Marcus?
I love Marcus. He fixed my television. He listens to my fish stories.
There are a lot of fish stories.
Then why are you stopping the wedding every two minutes?
Because it is late. It was supposed to be here at two.
What was supposed to be here?
When you were six, you said one thing about your wedding. Do you remember?
I said I wanted a horse.
The other thing.
An ice cream truck. I wanted an ice cream truck at my wedding.
And I said, Grandpa will handle it. So Grandpa handled it.
But the truck got lost. The driver called me from a parking lot. Twice.
So the chairs, the duck shoes, the raisin, the bird?
Stalling. I am eighty one. I am very good at stalling.
I can hear music. Is that a little song coming down the street?
It is the truck! Grandpa, it is the truck!
Now you can get married. Go on. I will hold the cone.
You remembered for twenty years.
I forget my glasses every day. I do not forget you.
By the power of my borrowed microphone, I now pronounce you married.
Can I kiss the bride before the line gets long?
Hold on. The man in the truck is waving at me.
What is he saying?
Stop the wedding. They are out of chocolate.
